parameters.name: Divisions
parameters.description: Number of divisions (when Divisions per Line Strip).

parameters.name: Min Distance
parameters.description: Minimum distance between points (when By Curvature).

parameters.name: Max Distance
parameters.description: Maximum distance between points (when By Curvature).

parameters.name: Min Max Bias
parameters.description: Bias of point creation near min or max distance.

parameters.name: Control Points Attribute
parameters.description: Use attribute with 0/1 values to mark control points.

parameters.name: Control Points Attribute Name
parameters.description: Name of the control point attribute.

parameters.name: Independent Variable Attribute
parameters.description: Attribute for Points as Keyframes method.

parameters.name: Remove Unused Points
parameters.description: Remove points not referenced by primitives.

useCases: Resample curves for uniform point distribution
Adaptive subdivision based on curvature (By Curvature)
Use keyframe attributes for time-based resampling
Control point preservation for exact curve matching
examples: Curve POP → Line Resample (Divisions=20) → uniform point distribution
Line Resample (By Curvature, Min=0.01, Max=0.1) → adaptive detail

commonCombinations.description: Resample then transform for uniform effects
Uniform noise application on resampled lines

troubleshooting: Points not uniform: Check Resample Method parameter
Too many vertices: Reduce Maximum Number of Vertices
Control points not working: Ensure attribute has 0/1 values
description: Resamples line strips using 4 methods: Divisions per Line Strip, Distance between Points, By Curvature (adaptive), and Points as Keyframes (independent variable). Supports ControlPoints attribute to force resampled curve through exact control points. Does not change line shape (unlike Line Smooth POP).
